timeline.body: CIA and MI6 overthrew Prime Minister Mosaddegh, ending Iran's democratic experiment and installing Shah Pahlavi as a Western client ruler.
The Iranian Revolution toppled the Shah; the Islamic Republic severed ties with the United States and Israel, reversing decades of Cold War alliance.
Iraq invaded Iran with Western backing, killing 500,000 in the deadliest conventional war ever fought between developing nations.
The Gulf Cooperation Council was founded in Riyadh, uniting Bahrain, Kuwait, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, and the UAE as a security bloc in the shadow of the Iran-Iraq War.
The Strait of Hormuz is 104 miles long and as narrow as 24 miles, connecting the Persian Gulf to the Gulf of Oman.
Iran controls the northern shore; the UAE and Oman's Musandam exclave share the southern coast.
The tanker war saw over 450 attacks on merchant vessels in the Gulf and Strait, with Iraq responsible for 283 and Iran for 168.
The US launched Operation Praying Mantis against Iranian naval targets after a mine struck a US warship — the largest American naval engagement since World War II.
Iran began backing Hezbollah in Lebanon, opening the first front of a proxy conflict with Israel that would span four decades.
Iran supported Hamas in Palestine while Israel assassinated Iranian nuclear scientists and struck Iranian forces and allies inside Syria.
Iran and Saudi Arabia waged parallel proxy wars across Syria, Yemen, Bahrain, Lebanon, Qatar, and Iraq, competing for influence across the Muslim world.
The JCPOA nuclear deal offered Iran sanctions relief in exchange for limits on its nuclear program, brokered by the P5+1 and the European Union in Vienna.
The Iran-Israel proxy war escalated into direct military confrontations between the two countries for the first time.
Iran and Israel fought a 12-day war involving the United States, transforming a decades-long proxy conflict into open warfare.
Gulf states weigh military entry as the Hormuz blockade tightens and diplomatic signals grow increasingly contradictory.
Pakistani and Afghan clerics call to extend a pause to Eid al-Adha while Trump claims Iran gave an unspecified 'prize' on Hormuz.
"And if they incline to peace, then incline to it [also] and rely upon Allāh. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Knowing." — Quran 8:61

Ibn Kathir: This verse commands acceptance of genuine peace overtures, citing the Prophet's acceptance of the Treaty of Hudaybiyah — and warns that even if the enemy intends deception, Allah is sufficient as protector.

timeline.body: Nineteen hijackers turned four airliners into weapons; the United States launched the global war on terror and overhauled domestic security from the ground up.
The Aviation and Transportation Security Act federalized airport screening, creating TSA to replace the patchwork of private security firms that failed on September 11.
The Homeland Security Act created DHS — the largest federal reorganization in decades — and formed ICE by merging the Immigration and Naturalization Service with the U.S. Customs Service.
TSA screens passengers at every U.S. airport; ICE enforces immigration law and conducts criminal investigations — both housed under DHS.
DHS is the umbrella department for border control, immigration, transportation security, cybersecurity, and counterterrorism — roughly 240,000 employees across 22 absorbed agencies.
A government shutdown occurs when Congress fails to pass funding legislation before the fiscal year deadline, triggering what is officially called a lapse in appropriations.
Non-essential federal workers are furloughed; essential workers — those protecting human life or property — must report to work without a paycheck until funding is restored.
TSA screeners and ICE agents are classified as essential: the airports stay open, the lines get longer, and the workers do not get paid.
TSA agents are working unpaid for the second time as DHS funding lapses again, with long security lines forming at airports nationwide.
ICE ramps up enforcement operations at airports, militarizing spaces already strained by the staffing crisis.
Delta Air Lines suspends its VIP airport services for members of Congress — the same Congress whose funding failure left federal workers without paychecks.
A Senate deal to restore DHS funding is reportedly imminent.

tsa-ice-dhs-shutdown.label: TSA workers unpaid in second shutdown as ICE militarizes airports
